h1: Centara Q Resort Rayong — a quiet Mae Phim beach you can drive straight to, no boat
intro: Most people assume a Rayong beach trip means a boat across to Koh Samet — but on the mainland at Mae Phim Beach in Klaeng there's a long stretch of sand, clear water and far more quiet, and you can drive right up to it. Centara Q Resort Rayong is a small 38-room resort in the Centara group, sitting on the Laem Mae Phim headland with many rooms facing straight out to sea. Guests mostly praise the beach and the calm, even if parts of the resort are starting to show their age. From approx. THB 1,900/night. Scored 8.2 from 132 Trip.com reviews.

body.html: Most travellers heading for the Rayong coast make for Ban Phe pier and the boat across to Koh Samet. But drive a little further toward Klaeng and you reach Mae Phim Beach, a long mainland stretch of sand that's quieter and that you can drive straight up to — no boat. Centara Q Resort Rayong sits on the Laem Mae Phim headland, opened in 2015, a small resort of just 38 rooms in the Centara group. Guests agree the first thing that sells it is the beach in front: pretty and calm, with several reviews calling it the best beach on this stretch of Rayong right now.

There are 38 rooms, from around 34 sqm up, starting with garden-view Superiors and rising to the ocean-facing categories like Deluxe Ocean Facing Twin and Deluxe Ocean Facing King. Every room has a balcony, air-con, a TV and a hot-water bathroom. What guests praise most are the comfortable beds, the sea view from the balcony, and the room size. Honestly, though, some reviews note that certain rooms and facilities are beginning to age — a few broken fittings here and there — and would like to see updates. If you want a sea view, specify the Ocean Facing group when you book, as the garden-view rooms don't see the water.
"Open the balcony door to the sea and a cool breeze, walk a few steps down to the sand — the beach was so quiet there was almost no one on it. We drove right up to it, no boat like going to Samet."

The heart of the resort is the beachfront outdoor pool with a poolside bar looking out over Mae Phim. There are sun loungers on the sand for the whole day, a playground for families, a spa and a gym. Water activities like snorkelling and kayaking are on offer too. The overall mood is quiet and unhurried — better for an easy beach escape than for nightlife, as the area around the resort is calm and the shops aren't as dense as in a big tourist town.

On food, the resort has a seaside restaurant and bar serving Thai and international dishes. Several reviews single out the beach bar as a fine spot to wind down in the evening, watching the sun and listening to the waves. The staff are a steady source of praise — friendly, attentive and helpful. Breakfast scores fairly well, though some guests find the dining room a little small and would like more menu variety.

Getting there is easier than many expect. From Bangkok it's about 3.5 hours by motorway and the Sukhumvit road to Mae Phim Beach, and you drive right up to the resort — no boat transfer. The trade-off is that the location is fairly far from Rayong town and other sights, so you'll want your own car to get around. It scores 8.2 from 132 Trip.com reviews and ranks #2 of 21 hotels in Klaeng on TripAdvisor — numbers that reflect how much guests like the beach and the service.

Honestly, Centara Q Resort Rayong isn't for travellers who want a brand-new resort in every corner, or who want nightlife. It's been open for years, some areas are dated, and Mae Phim is quiet with few shops nearby. But if you want a calm, pretty beach, an ocean-view room and friendly service at a reachable price — and you'd rather not spend time on a boat across to an island — this is a well-judged choice on Mae Phim Beach.

A tip from following the reviews here for a while: choose the Ocean Facing group and ask about room condition before you book, because the sea view from the balcony is what makes the rate worth it. Coming by your own car is most convenient, so you can stop for seafood or markets in Klaeng town. In high season and on long weekends (November–April) book ahead, as the resort is small and Mae Phim Beach is getting more popular.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Centara Q Resort Rayong

faq.q: Where is Centara Q Resort Rayong and how do you get there?
faq.a: It sits on Mae Phim Beach (Laem Mae Phim) in Tambon Kram, Klaeng, Rayong Province — a long mainland beach that's quiet with clear water. From Bangkok it's about 3.5 hours by motorway and the Sukhumvit road, and the big plus is that you drive right up to the resort and beach — no boat across to an island like Koh Samet.

faq.q: How much does Centara Q Resort Rayong cost and what rooms are there?
faq.a: Rates start from approx. THB 1,900/night for a Superior Garden View. From there you have the Deluxe Ocean Facing rooms (sea-facing) in both Twin and King, plus family rooms and suites. Prices vary by season and package — compare a few platforms before booking, and specify the Ocean Facing group if you want a sea view.

faq.q: How is Mae Phim Beach different from Koh Samet?
faq.a: Mae Phim Beach is on the mainland — you drive right up to it, no boat — and it's far quieter than Sai Kaew Beach on Koh Samet. It suits travellers who want a calm escape without the time spent on a boat. But if you want a lively scene, lots of shops, or coral snorkelling, Koh Samet delivers more of that.

faq.q: Who is Centara Q Resort Rayong best for?
faq.a: It's ideal for families and couples who want a quiet, pretty beach and prefer to drive in. There's a beachfront pool, a playground, sea-view rooms and friendly service. It's less suited to travellers who want a brand-new resort in every corner or nightlife, as it's been open for years and Mae Phim is quiet.

faq.q: What condition are the rooms and resort in?
faq.a: The resort opened in 2015. Guests praise the comfortable beds, the sea view from the balcony and the staff service. But some reviews note that certain rooms and facilities are dated, with a few broken fittings. It's worth asking for a room in good condition and the Ocean Facing group when you book.

faq.q: What review score does Centara Q Resort Rayong have?
faq.a: It scores 8.2 from 132 Trip.com reviews and ranks #2 of 21 hotels in Klaeng on TripAdvisor — reflecting how much guests like the beach, the calm and the service, even if some would like the rooms refreshed.
